context: Naoko teaches Sho-young an old folk song melody.
purpose: Aunt sharing musical heritage with child.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: この歌、ばあちゃんから習ったで。
lines.en: I learned this song from your grandmother, you know.
lines.style: Warm Kansai lilt on the opening. Soft, fond nostalgia — she's reaching back in time. Gentle pace, letting the memory sit. Slight breathy quality, like she's smiling as she speaks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Immediate brightness. Quick attack on 「面白い」 with genuine delight. High, clear voice. Lean forward with energy. No hesitation — pure discovery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Brassy, commanding Kansai warmth. Bright and loud but not harsh — an invitation wrapped in certainty. Clap of energy on 「歌う」. She's already pulling him in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet determination underneath the words. Earnest, focused — he's taking this seriously. Soft but steady pace. Small child voice, big promise. No wavering.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: That's my good boy — let's enjoy this!
lines.style: Animated Kansai warmth, full-bodied. Affectionate on the opening. Bright, open-hearted delivery. She's proud and excited at once. Slight laugh-line underneath, like she's already imagining it.
